name: Vanquis Banking Group plc
summary: Vanquis Banking Group plc is a financial services company specializing in providing personal credit solutions. It primarily serves the non-standard lending market across the United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland. Its portfolio of offerings includes credit cards and unsecured personal loans. The group also extends vehicle financing options for a range of assets, such as cars, motorcycles, and light commercial vehicles. With a history stretching back to its founding in 1880, the company is headquartered in Bradford, UK. Notably, the business rebranded from its former identity, Provident Financial plc, to Vanquis Banking Group plc in March 2023.
